content: {"rule":"RESULT","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text awards DEFENDER WINS and recites a challenge-standing and collision grade, so it does the thing the RESULT rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with \"dates the finding\" and \"bounds the stated abstinence,\" so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.","rule_words":"HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.","room":"\"A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count\": I weighed (1) retraction strips the PROP-DEPENDENT standing's reliance on the retracted D2 vs C3 broken grade, so the standing cannot supply the required condition, versus (2) the retraction affects only the collision grade and leaves the standing's stated reason intact.","why":"Because the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade is expressly retracted and the standing's stated reason depends on that retracted grade, the defender's win does not meet the rule's condition."}
